# Test fixtures

All six files are generated by [`generate_fixtures.py`](generate_fixtures.py) and committed
so the test suite is hermetic — it needs no generation step, no network, and no access to any
document corpus.

Regenerate with:

```bash
uv run python tests/fixtures/generate_fixtures.py
```

The script self-checks its output and will fail loudly if a fixture loses the structural
property the tests depend on.

| File | Size | What it exercises |
|---|---|---|
| `sample_unicode.pdf` | ~21 KB | Born-digital Sinhala Unicode in a subset-embedded Iskoola Pota, plus an ASCII span. No conversion should occur. |
| `sample_legacy_font.pdf` | ~1 KB | A non-embedded `/BaseFont /FMAbhaya` span carrying real FM-Abhaya bytes, beside a `/Helvetica` span holding `www.edupub.gov.lk`. The core non-corruption regression. |
| `sample_scanned.pdf` | ~25 KB | Image-only page, no text layer, image covering ~100% of the page. Drives the OCR decision. |
| `sample_mixed.pdf` | ~45 KB | Page 0 born-digital, page 1 image-only. Proves the OCR decision is per-page, not per-document. |
| `sample.docx` | ~37 KB | One paragraph mixing an FMAbhaya run, an Iskoola Pota run and an unstyled run; plus a 2×2 table mixing legacy and Unicode cells. |
| `sample.xlsx` | ~6 KB | Two sheets, FM-font cells, a formula cell, empty cells and a default-font cell. |

## Provenance of the sample strings

- **`LEGACY_SINHALA`** — `wOHdmk m%ldYk fomd¾;fïka;=j`. Real FM-Abhaya legacy bytes, the
  Sinhala for "Educational Publications Department". Verified to convert through
  pandukabhaya's `fm_abhaya` table to `අධ්‍යාපන ප්‍රකාශන දෙපාර්තමේන්තුව`.
- **`ASCII_CONTROL`** — `www.edupub.gov.lk`. This exact string was corrupted into
  `අඅඅගැාමචමඉගටදඩගකන` by the prior prototype's blanket conversion. It is present in every
  fixture that contains legacy text, purely so the regression has something to assert on.
- **`UNICODE_SINHALA`** — the same phrase already in correct Unicode. Blanket conversion
  mangles it (dot leaders become `ගගගග`), so it guards the never-convert path.

## Why no real corpus documents

The real Sinhala textbooks used during design (2.4–8.7 MB each) are third-party copyrighted
material and are deliberately **not** committed. They live outside the repo and are used only
for manual smoke runs, never by the test suite.

## Note on the legacy fixture

No FM Abhaya TTF is embedded — the font is proprietary and none was available. It is not
needed: the only two things the code under test consumes are the span's font *name* and its
raw *bytes*, and PyMuPDF surfaces both correctly for a non-embedded font resource. A PDF
viewer will render substituted glyphs, which is irrelevant here.
